lines: Hi! I'm Juniper, star reporter for the Old Oak Elementary newsletter! Can I ask you three questions? Question one: where are you from? Question two: why? Question three: do you like newts?
I'm investigating why Gus is grumpy. So far: no clues. Just pie.
Recess! Ten minutes of freedom. I'm interviewing the hopscotch.

rotate: Breaking news: the big oak hummed at bedtime. My mum says it's the wind. The wind doesn't hum in tune!
Exclusive: Mr. Palmer was seen standing by the old oak at midnight. He said he was 'checking on it'. Checking on a TREE?
I want to interview Nina's family but Bruno says 'no comment' and skates off. Every time!
